name: real-reel-drama
description: Real Reel Drama - Meagan Johnson's vertical drama website and its CMS

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix client --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix client
